sub_site: whole blood RNA-seq of healthy individuals (Indonesia; comparison Mali, UK)

data_source.dataset: Natri et al. Indonesian whole-blood RNA-seq (EGAS00001003671); Tran et al. Mali; UK London dataset

evidence.quote: we analysed unmapped reads from previously published whole blood transcriptomes
we also analysed microbiome data from two other publicly available datasets of whole blood transcriptomes
only reads that did not map to the h
After removing singletons to prevent spurious identification of taxa

notes: Analyses mostly at phylum/family level; dominated by Plasmodiidae and Flaviviridae (non-bacterial). Only bacterial genus named is Corynebacterium (C. tuberculostearicum, Malian cohort), reported in Discussion as own result. Authors find no core blood microbiome; describe transient taxa. Xanthomonadaceae (family) noted as possible kitome contaminant. n = 117 Indonesia + 54 Mali + 12 UK. No supplements available.
